responsibility: This target pass-definition fragment injects PRU-specific validation passes into GCC’s pass pipeline. It does not implement the checks itself; instead it declares where PRU backend passes are scheduled relative to generic passes, currently adding the TI ABI conformance checker and the minimal-runtime compatibility checker so PRU-specific diagnostics run at the intended GIMPLE pass points when options such as -mabi=ti or -minrt are enabled.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/config/pru/pru-passes.cc, which defines the PRU GIMPLE pass classes and their TI ABI and -minrt checking logic, this .def file is only the pass-pipeline placement fragment. It uses INSERT_PASS_AFTER entries to schedule pru_tiabi_check and pru_minrt_check relative to generic passes, without implementing the diagnostics themselves.
